summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the format entry (\x1b]0;{title}\x07) and Control.title(title); rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor, returning False when not a terminal; rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: Control.title test in tests/test_control.py, console test skipped on win32 in tests/test_console.py, and Windows-only renderer test in tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Results are unverified because tests were not run.
